_comment: Runtime NPC form-generation recipe (research/PROCGEN_NPC_FORMS.md §1/§5/§11). Backs the generate_npc adapter action. ProcgenNpc mints a brand-new TESNPC_ base by Copy()ing the 'template', applies the overrides below, places a ref near the anchor, and co-saves THIS recipe + the template's plugin FormID + position so the NPC is REBUILT on reload (logical persistence, not engine stable-FormID identity — see the doc's caveats). NEVER stores the 0xFF dynamic FormID.
_template_note: 0x0001BCD8 = vanilla generic 'Bandit' base in Skyrim.esm (a Light-Armored, One-Handed-Melee, level-1 male actor — a COMPLETE, fully-rigged actor base with race/skeleton/AI/voice/outfit), so the minted Copy() is immediately usable without hand-filling the ~12 TESActorBase components (research/PROCGEN_NPC_FORMS.md §1.2). Source/confidence: VERIFIED — '0001BCD8' is listed as 'Bandit' on the skyrimcharactercodes base-ID list AND described as 'Bandit Light Armored One-Handed Melee, level 01, Male' in the Steam 'Pocket Guide to the Empire: Summoning'. NOTE: the previous placeholder 0x0001327B was NOT in any Bandit base-ID list and is replaced. Accepts '0x..~Mod.esp', a bare '0x..' absolute id, or an EditorID. To use a friendlier citizen instead, see _citizen_alt below.
_citizen_alt: If a non-hostile 'citizen' template is preferred, the engine's own player base 0x00000007~Skyrim.esm is a complete actor (used as a template by NpcGenerator.cpp:63) but is the PLAYER record (overriding its name/flags on a Copy is fine since we Copy() into a fresh base). A bandit is chosen here only because it is a generic LEVELED combat actor with no quest entanglements. Swap by editing the 'template' field above; no code change needed.
_persist_key_note: Stable string id = the logical identity carried across save/reload. On load the NPC is re-minted and re-tracked under this key. If omitted, ProcgenNpc auto-generates one (gen_npc_N).
name: Procedural Citizen
_overrides_note: name -> TESFullName::SetFullName on the minted base. sex -> kFemale ACTOR_BASE_DATA flag. essential -> kEssential flag. level -> ACTOR_BASE_DATA::level. scale -> ref-level SetScale (research §4 '體格'). Deep appearance procgen (headparts/faceData morph/tint) is inherited from the template (research §4: Copy carries the baked face) and is left as a TODO.
_caveats: This recipe survives reload only as a REBUILT fresh instance (the engine never saves a runtime-minted TESNPC base — research §3). The original ref FormID, any quest alias pointing at the old base, and TESNPC::relationships do NOT carry over and would need re-linking. For 'the same logical NPC reappears' this is enough; for 'another mod references it by FormID forever' an ESP/ESL is required (research §6/§8).
